slices.focus: Nathaniel and Monica pitch a corridor reliability playbook to leadership; it is approved for testing in future planning cycles.
slices.summary: After three signup periods of sustained results, Nathaniel and Monica pitch a formal corridor reliability playbook to leadership. It is approved for testing in future planning cycles, including realistic running time review, operator input before signup, and cleaner exception tracking.
